safety_rules: **Redirect command output to log files** - long output crashes context
**Test changes with go build before committing**
**Run go build ./cmd/accumulated to verify build after changes**
**Do NOT delete files until imports are updated**

epics.title: Remove CometBFT and make DAG-BFT the default consensus
epics.description: Epic issue that tracks the complete removal of CometBFT from accumulated. Sub-issues must be completed in order due to dependencies.

issues.title: Wire GossipSub into accumulated integration
issues.description: Wire GossipSub networking into the DAG-BFT service in accumulated.

issues.title: Implement BPT sync recovery
issues.description: Implement BPT (Binary Patricia Trie) sync for state recovery when nodes diverge or fall behind. This is needed for robustness but not blocking the integration test.

issues.title: Run 7 accumulated validators with DAG-BFT
issues.description: Run 7 accumulated validator nodes (each with BVN + DN) using DAG-BFT consensus for 30 minutes.

issues.description: Modify core_validator.go to create DAGBFTService instead of ConsensusService. This is the critical first step to enable DAG-BFT in accumulated.

issues.title: Remove ConsensusService from types.go
issues.description: Remove ConsensusService and CoreConsensusApp type registrations from types.go after core_validator.go is updated.
